annotations.title: Make a project public or private

description: Use only when the user asks to make one of their projects public, or private again. public=true: anyone can then open the project, its documents (including the user's own uploaded files in it) and its answers, through the returned link and on GeoThought's public pages; allow_ask lets visitors ask it questions. public=false: private again, and the link stops working. Returns the link and a `tell_user` text that says what was opened or closed; give it to the user.
name: geothought_publish_project
title: Make a project public or private
